about: Photographs the election offices' own guides print beside a candidate's name, with no image address to link: each joined to the person by the guide's page naming them beside it, for that office (kyc/guide_photos.py; rules 24, 87, 91, 101). The file is hosted unmodified under photos/ and listed in data/photo_copies.json ('hosted'). Hand-editable.

AK.credit: from the Alaska Division of Elections' Official Election Pamphlet
AK.terms: The elections site carries 'Copyright (c) 2026 Alaska Division of Elections'; its disclaimer grants no reuse. Hosted unmodified, credited and linked, by the owner's decision of 2026-10-25.
AK.title: Candidates - Division of Elections: 2026 General Election (Official Candidate Statements)

AZ.credit: from the Arizona Citizens Clean Elections Commission's candidate list
AZ.terms: Each picture has an address of its own on the Commission's site and is linked there, credited to the list it is printed in, not hosted here; the Commission's site states no terms of reuse.
AZ.title: Find My Candidates - Citizens Clean Elections Commission (all candidates, November 3, 2026 General Election)

OR.converted: converted by this site to PNG from the pamphlet's JPEG 2000 image, pixel for pixel
OR.credit: from the Oregon Secretary of State's State Voters' Pamphlet
OR.terms: Oregon's general terms grant no reuse; the photographs are the candidates' own submissions. The pamphlet holds each as JPEG 2000, which no browser draws: decoded losslessly here (kyc/jpx.py, the reversible 5/3 wavelet, every pixel as coded) and hosted as PNG, credited and linked to its page, by the owner's decision of 2026-10-25.
OR.title: State Voters' Pamphlet, General Election November 3, 2026 (one book per county)

UT.credit: from the Utah Lieutenant Governor's Office's Voter Information Pamphlet
UT.terms: The pamphlet says 'Federal candidates were given the opportunity to submit a statement and a photograph'; utah.gov's disclaimer lets anyone 'view, copy, or distribute information found within these web pages ... for personal or informational use ... if the documents are not modified in any respect'. Hosted unmodified, credited and linked to its page, by the owner's decision of 2026-10-25.
UT.title: Utah's Official Voter Information Pamphlet, General Election, Tuesday, November 3, 2026

WA.credit: from the Washington Secretary of State's voters' guide
WA.terms: The guide's footer reads 'Copyright (c) 2026 Washington Secretary of State'; the office's web policy says third-party photographs are 'copyrighted by others' and used with their holders' permission. Hosted unmodified, credited and linked, by the owner's decision of 2026-10-25.
WA.title: Online voters' guide, November 3, 2026 General Election
